title: Hour buttons look big and invasive
symptom: On a 5.5" Full HD phone, the hour buttons look big and invasive, with a large grey box behind them, crowding the screen which is already filled with information, graphs, and symbols.
fix: The issue was reported as resolved in the Aug 19th Nightly, but the user reported no change in the hour buttons after updating. No specific fix was confirmed.
evidence_quote: Please try the Aug 19th Nightly. I believe this problem should be resolved.
